labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a new SpeedColumn class, which is a feature request

items.body:
This asks for a new `SpeedColumn` class, so it is a feature request. Per the feature template, new features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there.

Rich already has `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)`, which shows speed only when `total` is unknown, and `TransferSpeedColumn`, which assumes bytes. For a custom unit today, you can subclass [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) and render `task.finished_speed or task.speed` with your own unit. An earlier related request is #3835.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
